rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for a hug, especially in 「畀我一個抱抱」.

example.english: Give me an embrace; I’m really tired today.
example.traditional: 畀我一個抱抱，我今日真係好攰。
example.jyutping: bei2 ngo5 jat1 go3 pou5 pou5 ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6

rows.note: Use this more formal or written noun when describing an embrace in serious or polished language.

example.english: This embrace gave me the strength to carry on.
example.traditional: 呢個擁抱令我重新振作。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jung2 pou5 ling6 ngo5 cung4 san1 zan3 zok3
